course_name_original: MRP avancé, juste à temps et lean

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamental differences between push and pull production.
Be familiar with and be able to implement the continuous improvement techniques of just-in-time and lean manufacturing.

syllabus_topics: Just-in-time production: Context, Principles, Methods (line-up, SMED (Single Minute Exchange of Die), Poka Yoke, Kanban...)
Between MRP and just-in-time: the OPT (Optimized Production Technology) method
Case studies from the railway industry
